sentences.text: Shri Mukesh Parwal, G.A. for State.

Order 
This is sixth bail application under section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of regular bail in connection with crime no. 83/2020 registered at P.S. Machalpur district Rajgarh for the offence punishable under sections 302, 304b, 498a r/w 34 of IPC..

The fifth bail application has been rejected on merit considering the Dying declaration of the deceased that she had made specific allegation against the applicant and other co-accused with regard to caught hold hands of deceased and pouring kerosene on her by the husband and other co-accused.
The present bail application has been filed mainly on the ground of delay in trial.
Considering the same, status report was called and as per the status report, out of 14 prosecution witnesses, 10 have already been examined.
Considering the same and the previous order, this Court is not inclined to grant bail to the applicant at present.

However, it is observed that trial court shall make all endeavours to conclude the trial as expeditiously as possible preferably within a period of 4 months from today and if the trial is not concluded within the aforesaid period, liberty is granted to the applicant to revive his application.
